newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cr Foncier to resume search for buyer.
newsitem.headline: Cr Foncier to resume search for buyer.

text.p: The search for a buyer for French home loans lender Credit Foncier will resume at the end of the month and be "actively pursued in June and July," bank governor Jerome Meyssonnier said on Wednesday.
"The (sale) dossier will be available from next week," he told an annual shareholders' meeting.
The finance ministry had planned to break up the lender after it posted a 10.6 billion franc loss in 1995.
But staff waged a strong campaign to save the lender, arguing it could continue to operate with the help of a partner and fresh capital.
The ministry decided in March to try again to find a purchaser after the bank's profits improved.
The lender reported 1996 consolidated profit of 858 million francs.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell has been appointed to help find a new owner.
